title: Campaign
description: A series of sessions a group plays in a world. Out-of-universe: a campaign is a record of play, not of the world, so it is marked out-of-universe and dated in real time rather than in a calendar of the fiction.

perspective.description: Out-of-universe by default: this is a record of play, not something that exists in the fiction.

gamemaster.description: User id of whoever runs it. A user, not a person in the world: running a game is not something that happens in the fiction.

party.description: The adventuring party, a faction whose factionType is party.

setting.description: Where in the world it is set, if it is bounded to one place.

beganOn.description: Real-world date of the first session.

inWorldTime.description: Where the party currently stands in the world's own calendar.
